models.description: MACE foundation MLIP trained on Materials Project trajectories (MPTrj); ASE calculator via mace_mp.

models.name: CHGNet
models.description: Charge-informed universal GNN potential for materials; pretrained CHGNet weights ship with the package.

models.name: M3GNet (MatGL)
models.description: Materials 3-body Graph Network universal potential via MatGL (PyTorch).

models.name: SevenNet
models.description: Scalable equivariant GNN interatomic potential (NequIP-style) with ASE / LAMMPS support.

models.name: ORB v3
models.description: Orbital Materials ORB-v3 universal potentials (OMat24); conservative and direct variants.

models.name: MatterSim
models.description: Microsoft MatterSim deep learning atomistic model across elements, temperatures, and pressures.

models.name: FAIRChem UMA / eSEN
models.description: FAIR Chemistry UMA (and related eSEN) foundation models via fairchem-core ASE calculator. UMA/eSEN checkpoints are often gated on Hugging Face.
models.license: MIT (code); model weights under FAIR Chemistry License / gated HF
models.notes: Weights may require HF_TOKEN and access approval (facebook/UMA).

models.name: GRACE
models.description: Graph Atomic Cluster Expansion (GRACE) via TensorPotential / gracemaker.
models.notes: Foundational GRACE potentials: arXiv:2508.17936. Package verified on PyPI.

models.name: ALIGNN-FF
models.description: JARVIS ALIGNN force field (89 elements) for structural optimization and dynamics.
models.license: NIST public domain / Terms of Use
models.notes: PyPI homepage currently points at atomgptlab/alignn; NIST repo remains canonical reference.

models.name: ALIGNN (pretrained)
models.description: Atomistic Line Graph Neural Network with JARVIS pretrained property models (gaps, moduli, spectra, etc.).
models.license: NIST public domain / Terms of Use

models.name: MEGNet band gap (MatGL)
models.description: MEGNet / MatGL pretrained Materials Project multi-fidelity band-gap models.

models.name: CGCNN
models.description: Crystal Graph Convolutional Neural Networks for material property prediction; pretrained checkpoints in repo (no PyPI package).
models.install_cmd: git clone https://github.com/txie-93/cgcnn.git && cd cgcnn && pip install -e .
models.notes: Install from GitHub; not published as a standalone PyPI package.

models.name: Mat2Spec
models.description: Materials-to-spectrum model for phonon and electronic DOS via probabilistic embeddings + contrastive learning.
models.notes: Repo verified; LICENSE file not confirmed — marked unverified for license.

models.name: e3nn phonon DOS
models.description: Euclidean neural net for direct phonon DOS prediction from crystal structure (Chen et al.).
models.notes: GitHub license listed as Other; treat license as unverified. Notebook/research code, not a pip package.

models.name: O-kRystal
models.description: Dual-space orbital learning for beyond-DFT band structures (PBE→HSE06 / G0W0 corrections). Code not released.

models.name: DeepH-E3
models.description: E(3)-equivariant neural network for DFT Hamiltonian prediction (DeepH-E3).
models.install_cmd: git clone https://github.com/Xiaoxun-Gong/DeepH-E3.git && cd DeepH-E3 && pip install -e .
models.notes: Authors recommend DeepH-pack for new users. No PyPI package.

models.name: DeepH-pack
models.description: Official DeepH toolkit for deep-learning DFT Hamiltonians. Download may require academic license application.
models.install_cmd: git clone https://github.com/mzjb/DeepH-pack.git && cd DeepH-pack && pip install .

models.name: HamGNN
models.description: E(3)-equivariant graph neural network for ab initio tight-binding Hamiltonians.
models.notes: No PyPI package; install from GitHub.

models.name: QHNet
models.description: Equivariant quantum Hamiltonian network (AIRS/OpenDFT); QH9 benchmark baseline.
models.notes: Lives inside the AIRS monorepo; no standalone PyPI package.

models.name: SchNOrb
models.description: SchNet-based deep neural network for molecular wavefunctions / Hamiltonians.

models.name: CAREamics Noise2Void
models.description: PyTorch Noise2Void / CARE denoising toolbox (CAREamics) for scientific imaging.
models.notes: N2V paper cited; CAREamics is the modern PyTorch packaging.

models.name: Swin2SR
models.description: SwinV2 Transformer for compressed image super-resolution and restoration (Hugging Face).
models.license: Apache-2.0 (typical for HF Swin2SR weights; verify per checkpoint)
